publication: No staging, commits, pushes, remote issues, or releases performed.
scope: Twenty local retrieval, reviewed-memory and bounded routing/cache stories.

architecture.local_retrieval: Use existing tenant-scoped SQLite and a deterministic lexical-trigram encoder for the local desktop slice. Requiring PostgreSQL/team deployment before local retrieval was rejected. VEY-113 and VEY-202 remain separate backlog work.
architecture.memory: Keep coupled review/retraction/export transactions in one memory store instead of thin wrappers for each planned file. Existing typed memory contracts remain intact.
architecture.design: Preserve the approved Veya Work console, Public Sans/Phosphor, compact navigation and contextual task Activity. Data review separates Examples and Lessons. Verify desktop/narrow layouts and keyboard/failure states in this batch.

verification.runtime_note: Full 641-test suite passed; final focused run covers four additional indexing/consent/reranker race tests and final guards. Counts overlap; do not add them.
verification.python: ruff check/format, mypy 143 source files, generated OpenAPI/TypeScript contract v9, evaluation-tooling checks passed.
verification.go: Go vet and all four tested packages passed, including new allowlist and identity-forgery tests.
verification.frontend: pnpm check, pnpm build (342.68 kB raw / 80.44 kB estimated transfer), and 9 frontend tests passed.
verification.browser: Real Angular → Go → Python memory approval, stale edit preservation, retraction, erasure, export, attribution and candidate flows passed. Axe and keyboard checks at 1440/375; screenshots inspected. Existing document/provider browser regressions passed.
verification.repository: 27 unittest checks, owned module boundaries, actionlint v1.7.7 and git diff --check passed.
verification.final_browser_fix: Final browser pass verified proposal stays disabled until run identity is loaded; retained final screenshots show the separate Lessons selector and local-only memory disclosure.

limitations: Stories remain in_review: user commits and formal prerequisite acceptance are pending.
Local vector features are lexical, not a qualified semantic embedding model; no PostgreSQL/team deployment was implemented.
Reranking and automatic cost routing accept trusted host adapters/qualification records; no production reranker or model was qualified in this batch.
Memory is currently personal-workspace scoped and excluded from hosted-provider prompts until separate memory consent exists.
Synthetic contract/scenario tests do not establish real-model task quality, memory transfer improvements, native installed QA or signed release readiness.
GitHub CI has not run these local changes. Existing R1 model-quality and installed/signed Windows release gaps remain open.

VEY-112.assessment: Resumable content-addressed indexing reuses unchanged chunks, isolates model revisions, validates dimensions, and fences late/revoked publication. A failed job remains retryable.

VEY-114.assessment: Lexical, vector and reciprocal-rank fusion operate over the same authorized local corpus. Empty results are explicit. SQLite supports the local slice; PostgreSQL remains VEY-113.

VEY-115.assessment: Attachment, tenant, source-version and effective-time checks run before ranking and again before context consumption. Revoked/future sources are excluded, including late reranker revocation.

VEY-116.assessment: Optional trusted asynchronous reranking preserves source identity, supports a disabled baseline and reports timeout/invalid-score fallback without invented scores.

VEY-117.assessment: Context includes whole permitted source records with identity, version, offsets and an untrusted-data envelope. Oversized records are skipped explicitly; default counting is conservative UTF-8 bytes.

VEY-118.assessment: Retrieval labels distinguish missed evidence, omitted context, unsupported answers, permission failures and generation failures. Unsupported correct answers cannot count as grounded success.

VEY-119.assessment: Repeated lexical/vector/hybrid benchmark runs retain corpus/model/query versions, query digest, complete failure denominators and family/exact-query leakage flags.

VEY-120.assessment: New source versions require an observable indexing checkpoint; revocation purges indexes and cached vectors/responses. Existing tasks retain explicitly attached historical versions.

VEY-122.assessment: Candidate lessons come from bounded known durable failure codes and source runs. They remain drafts. Secret-bearing text, unsupported universal rules and unsupported failures are rejected.

VEY-123.assessment: Data review → Lessons supports editing, explicit activation/retraction, revision conflict recovery and preserved drafts through authenticated Go commands. Reviewer identity is host-owned.

VEY-124.assessment: Only current same-tenant/workspace/owner active lessons enter local-only model task context. Hosted selections omit prior-task memory because existing remote consent does not cover it.

VEY-125.assessment: Different active lessons for the same failure topic cannot silently override one another. Explicit retraction is required before activating conflicting content; lessons never change tool policy.

VEY-126.assessment: Thirty-day expiry and explicit retraction stop subsequent use; in-flight tasks reject stale lesson revisions. Immutable historical attribution remains visible.

VEY-127.assessment: Bounded traversal exposes actual run/memory/source relationships with cycle detection, owner filtering, depth/node/edge limits and explicit truncation.

VEY-128.assessment: Activity shows exact contributed lesson revisions and historical source runs. Erased lessons remain explicitly unavailable in history instead of disappearing.

VEY-129.assessment: Paired held-out memory reports retain complete outcomes and scope contamination flags. Training-family or answer-hash overlap excludes transfer eligibility; fixture reports do not demonstrate model improvement.

VEY-130.assessment: Owner-scoped JSON export includes reviewed records and history. Confirmed erasure removes lesson text from all revisions, invalidates inference cache and names retained source/audit evidence.

VEY-171.assessment: Versioned reproducible routing features use only pre-decision instruction/evidence sizes, document count, tool requirements and data classification. Final rewards/labels are not accepted inputs.

VEY-172.assessment: Trusted-host cost routing selects only qualified exact model fingerprints within task scope, capabilities, destination policy and comparable prices. Desktop defaults to explicit user selection; no real model is newly qualified.

VEY-174.assessment: Bounded read-only final-response cache keys exact model inputs, tenant/owner, grants and memory revisions. It requires a succeeded source run, rejects actions, records hits and rechecks evidence before result publication.
